propositions: A deterministic clarity floor for plan-review must retain exactly two hard rules: (1) nonempty parsed acceptance-criteria items and (2) unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections, with structural exclusions for removal assertions and code fences.

Exact-duplicate acceptance-criteria items must be reclassified from hard floor to advisory-only; counterexample 8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88 demonstrates a legitimate repeated global gate that passed both plan-review and completion review despite textual duplication.

Bare unresolved sentinels (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) must be retained as hard floor only when they occupy value assignment positions, with removal assertions suppressed; the earlier history-section exception is undefined and must be removed.
File-impact path/reason validation is a write-schema integrity invariant, not a clarity-floor concern, and should be enforced at mutation boundary only.

[rebar:id] direct-edge validation must be removed from raw clarity scoring and applied only in the grounding exception path when an absent file or symbol claims prerequisite-created credit; naive edge checking is disproven by legitimate provenance and downstream references.
